page.title: Guardrail center
page.desc: Every constraint the pricing engine enforces, with live coverage and breach counts for the current scope.

bounds.name: Price bounds
bounds.desc: Per-SKU minimum and maximum price, intersected with the governing strategy's bounds.

map.name: MAP policy
map.desc: Minimum advertised price. A proposal below MAP is blocked wherever enforcement is on.

max_change.name: Max change per cycle
max_change.desc: Largest single-move price change an active strategy permits, applied around the current price.

auto_approve.name: Auto-approve threshold
auto_approve.desc: Confidence above which a strategy proposal can skip manual review. Observational here — enforced at decision time.

margin_floor.name: Margin floor
margin_floor.desc: Active min-margin rules that hold a SKU's price at or above the margin floor.

staleness.name: Price staleness
staleness.desc: Days since the last price change. Tracked for review queues — not an enforced bound.

change_frequency.name: Change frequency
change_frequency.desc: Flags pending recommendations on SKUs repriced inside the quiet window.

inventory.name: Inventory constraint
inventory.desc: Flags price increases on SKUs that are low on stock or stocked out.

approval_threshold.name: Approval threshold
approval_threshold.desc: Recommendations above the impact gate need elevated approval before publishing.

promotion.name: Promotion constraint
promotion.detail: The demo catalog carries no promotion data.
promotion.why: No promotion data in the current catalog.
promotion.enable: Connect a promotion calendar feed in Data & integrations.

regulatory.name: Regulatory constraint
regulatory.desc: Price ceilings, subsidies and jurisdiction rules.
regulatory.detail: No jurisdiction data in the demo.
regulatory.why: No jurisdiction or price-control data in the current catalog.
regulatory.enable: Add a regulatory price-control source for each region.

channel.name: Channel constraint
channel.detail: Channels exist on publish jobs only.
channel.why: Channels exist on publish jobs only, not as price inputs.
channel.enable: Map channel price lists as a data source.

breaches.title: Current breaches
breaches.none: No SKU currently breaches a hard constraint.
breaches.caption: SKUs currently violating a guardrail

drill.title: Per-SKU drill-down
drill.noStrategy: No active strategy — product bounds only
drill.noRules: No active rule covers this SKU

filterHint: Click to filter the breach table
filterOn: Filtering the breach table — click to clear

mode.enforced: The pricing engine uses this constraint to block or modify decisions.
mode.observed: Tracked for decision context — not enforced at pricing time.
mode.unavailable: No current input is available for this constraint.
mode.breached: Enforced — some SKUs currently violate it.
mode.flagged: Observed — pending recommendations are flagged, not blocked.
